description: maximumCompactExponent and maximumVisibleDecimalPlaces lowered so ExpressionEvaluator.validatePluralOperands -- the evaluator's OWN copy of the plural-operand ceiling check, distinct from the placeholder-boundary one -- can be driven at its limit and one unit over it, on an expression operand. The corpus reaches this method only from the plural-form path, so a port enforcing these ceilings at the placeholder boundary and not on an expression operand passes everything today.
